About.title: I'm
About.intro: I write about AI filmmaking and personal knowledge systems, from a single shot or source note through handoff and review.

paragraphs: This blog starts with two questions: how do you cut an idea into a short film people can follow, and how do you find the evidence behind a decision when you need it again?
The filmmaking notes put scripts, narration, and storyboards through the same preview to see where shots, sound, and captions lose their connection.
The knowledge base notes begin with a small set of records. Source cards and an index connect clues to evidence, then specific questions test what can be recovered.
The timeline below collects the local demo articles by date. Open any article for the test steps, illustrations, and retrospective.
